Preserves the reviewed free-fracture pilot, formulation source evidence, explicit-surface fixtures, and MLS kernel API phases 1 and 2. The pilot records 6,810 right-grip separations, not internal physical fracture, and retains the 53-byte launcher receipt discrepancy. The explicit-surface and MLS evidence is NOT_COUPLED; the ROI geometry scope remains blocked. These artifacts do not qualify geometry, fracture physics, or an R2 workflow.
